purpose: Feasibility benchmark for correspondence and potential semantic defects in a supplied COBOL/Java pair. Synthetic proposed annotations are not production defect data, equivalence proofs, or measured model accuracy.

scope.programs: Complete stdin/stdout COBOL and Java programs.
scope.inputs: Canonical bounded ASCII numeric inputs only, at most 20 characters per line; exact field formats belong to each contract.
scope.output: One scalar numeric output per program; normalize only as declared in its contract.

splitPolicy: All variants, tests, fragments, and derived artifacts inherit their family split.
Related templates and shared algorithmic helpers must stay in one split. Names and clone-group identifiers do not establish independence.
Proposed design rationales require source-level clone review before any independent held-out generalization claim.
No existing validation or test source is moved into training.
Exclude IDs, variant order, split and clone metadata, defect annotations, rationales, and test outputs from model features.

generationStatus.independenceClaim: Twenty target algorithm families; cross-family independence is not certified by this manifest.

provenance.identityAuthority: User-supplied audited identity facts in the plan-repair request.
provenance.runtimeEvidencePolicy: Original runtime evidence applies only to the original bytes; none is attributed to F005-R2.

separateMetadataRepair.rationale: An unweighted mean replaces the required quantity-weighted quotient. That is a formula defect, not a rounding defect.

families.algorithmDescription: Invoice discount and tax: truncate subtotal*discount/100 to cents, subtract the discount, round tax on the net to cents, then ADD tax to the net.
families.contractPolicy: Preserve the audited source contract; unspecified widths and domains are not inferred here.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Two dependent percentage calculations with a net-balance intermediate. The archived old F005 belongs to this related-template review group and is excluded from the active test allocation.

families.algorithmDescription: Pro-rata subscription charge: round annual fee/365 to FOUR fractional places, multiply by days and round gross to cents, apply gross PIC 9(5)V99 storage truncation modulo 100000.00 BEFORE subtracting promotional credit, then floor at zero.
families.contractPolicy: Preserve the audited source contract; unspecified widths and domains are not inferred here.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Daily-rate quantization, multiplication by days, receiving-field reduction, and credit floor form the pipeline. F007 also exercises receiving-field reduction but uses a different additive pipeline; both are in train.

families.algorithmDescription: Triangulated FX: multiply base amount by the first four-decimal rate, truncate the intermediate to FOUR fractional places, multiply by the second rate, round settlement to cents, then subtract wire fee.
families.contractPolicy: Preserve the audited source contract; unspecified widths and domains are not inferred here.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Two rate multiplications with an intermediate scale-four storage boundary followed by settlement and a fee. F005-R2 has one rate multiplication and cash-denomination quantization; the common multiplication primitive alone does not establish independence.

families.algorithmDescription: Weighted inventory unit cost: sum each lot quantity*unit cost, divide by combined quantity, and round the final quotient to cents.
families.contractPolicy: Preserve the audited source contract; unspecified widths and domains are not inferred here.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Weighted numerator and quantity denominator differ from the three training pipelines. Its audited identity and validation assignment are preserved; V4 metadata is handled by the separate versioned record.

families.algorithmDescription: One FX conversion using a four-decimal rate, half-up cent rounding, then nearest-0.05 cash-denomination quantization.

validInputDomain.amount: Canonical ASCII decimal 0.00..50000.00, exactly 2 fractional digits.
validInputDomain.rate: Canonical ASCII decimal 0.0000..9.9999, exactly 4 fractional digits.

families.outputMeaning: One nonnegative scalar local-currency amount at scale two, a multiple of 0.05.
semanticFailureModes: Truncating instead of half-up rounding at the cent boundary.
Using a 0.10 cash denomination instead of 0.05.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Supplied source has a single conversion, scale-two rounding, rounded division by 0.05, and denomination reconstruction. It has neither F001's two percentages and net intermediate nor F003's second FX multiplication, scale-four intermediate, and fee subtraction. No shared FX algorithm helper is introduced.
families.supersedes: Archived batch-03 F005 compounded-interest revision only; original bytes and runtime evidence remain provenance.

families.algorithmDescription: Add a signed adjustment to the opening balance, store in an unsigned intermediate so a negative result loses its sign, then subtract a signed fee into a signed final balance.
families.contractPolicy: Preserve the audited source contract; unspecified widths and domains are not inferred here.
families.cloneGroupRationale: The sign-removing receiving-field boundary followed by signed subtraction is the defining structure. F002 is a different audited algorithm and is not assigned to this group.

families.algorithmDescription: Update a four-digit decimal odometer by adding an unsigned increment and storing only the low four decimal digits.
semanticFailureModes: Retaining a fifth digit instead of receiving-field truncation.
Saturating rather than wrapping.
Wrapping at 9999 rather than 10000.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Add-and-wrap structure differs from F006 sign removal. Its storage-reduction operation is also present in F002; both remain in train and no shared helper crosses a split.

families.algorithmDescription: Compute a normalized nonnegative remainder of a signed integer using truncation-toward-zero division, residual subtraction, and one negative-residual correction.
families.outputMeaning: One integer r in 0..divisor-1 congruent to dividend modulo divisor.
semanticFailureModes: Using floor division and then applying an extra correction.
Omitting the negative-residual correction.
Making the dividend absolute before division.
families.cloneGroupRationale: A single signed quotient/residual pipeline. F010 uses nonnegative Euclidean iteration after absolute-value normalization; it must not reuse this signed normalization helper.

families.algorithmDescription: Select the signed median of three integers with a fixed comparison-and-swap network using signed temporary storage.
families.outputMeaning: One signed integer equal to the middle value in numeric order; duplicates are retained.
semanticFailureModes: Using unsigned comparison or temporary storage.
Losing the sign during a swap.
Selecting the minimum or maximum instead of the median.
families.cloneGroupRationale: A fixed compare-and-swap network without a scan, arithmetic normalization, or shared sort helper. No other planned family sorts its input.

families.algorithmDescription: Compute the greatest common divisor of two signed integers by taking their magnitudes and running the Euclidean remainder loop.
families.outputMeaning: One positive integer gcd(abs(a),abs(b)), at most 99999.
semanticFailureModes: Returning a signed result.
Treating a zero operand as immediate zero output.
Overwriting an operand before using the old remainder divisor.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Repeated nonnegative Euclidean operand rotation differs from F008's single signed quotient and correction. Only primitive remainder arithmetic is common; no algorithmic helper may be shared across splits.

families.algorithmDescription: Calculate a progressive marginal charge: first 100 units cost 1 each, next 400 cost 2 each, and remaining units cost 3 each.
semanticFailureModes: Applying the highest reached rate to every unit.
Off-by-one tier boundaries.
Omitting the completed lower tiers.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Marginal tier accumulation is confined to train. No validation or test slot reuses a threshold-tier or ordered-first-match template.

families.algorithmDescription: Run a four-state numeric automaton over bounded numeric events: event 0 keeps the state, event 1 moves clockwise, and event 2 reflects state s to 3-s.

validInputDomain.eventCount: Integer 0..8 followed by that many event integers 0..2.

semanticFailureModes: Wrong event dispatch.
Applying reflection as increment.
Failing to preserve state for event zero.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Finite event-driven state composition with explicit dispatch, not an ordered predicate classifier. No interpreter or transition helper is shared outside train.

families.algorithmDescription: Apply a hysteresis deadband: values below -10 force state 0, values above 10 force state 1, and values in the closed interval [-10,10] preserve the previous state.
semanticFailureModes: Changing state at an inclusive deadband endpoint.
Resetting state inside the deadband.
Reversing the low and high actions.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Two-sided state retention differs from F011 marginal summation and F012 event composition; all branch-template relatives would remain in train.

families.algorithmDescription: Use integer bisection to find the largest n in 0..10000 with n*n+3*n no greater than a supplied budget.
families.outputMeaning: One integer n in 0..10000 satisfying the maximal affordable-lot condition.
semanticFailureModes: Using a strict rather than inclusive affordability test.
Losing the last feasible midpoint.
Incorrect termination or midpoint bounds.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Monotone bisection with a last-feasible invariant, not ordered first-match selection. No other slot uses binary search or its boundary helper.

families.algorithmDescription: Compute the total length covered by the union of two half-open numeric intervals, accounting for disjoint, touching, overlapping, and contained intervals.

validInputDomain.endpoints: Four integers a,b,c,d in 0..100000 with a<=b and c<=d, representing [a,b) and [c,d).

semanticFailureModes: Treating half-open endpoints as inclusive.
Counting overlap twice.
Treating touching endpoints as positive overlap.
Mishandling containment.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Geometric overlap length and inclusion-exclusion differ from tier charges, state dispatch, hysteresis, and bisection. No ordered first-match algorithm is reused.

families.algorithmDescription: Stably compact nonzero values in a bounded list and return the position-weighted sum of the compacted list using one-based retained positions.

validInputDomain.length: Integer 0..8 followed by that many integers -999..999.

families.outputMeaning: One signed integer sum(i*retained[i]), bounded by -35964..35964.
semanticFailureModes: Advancing the write index for discarded zeroes.
Using original rather than compacted positions.
Skipping the final input item.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Separate read/write indices with order-preserving compaction. No other proposed split uses a compaction or filtering helper.

families.algorithmDescription: Read a bounded square numeric matrix in row-major order and return its main-diagonal trace.

validInputDomain.dimension: Integer 1..4 followed by dimension squared integers -999..999.

families.outputMeaning: One signed integer diagonal sum, bounded by -3996..3996.
semanticFailureModes: Confusing row-major stride with the dimension minus one.
Selecting the anti-diagonal.
Missing the last diagonal cell.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Two-dimensional diagonal selection differs from compaction, Horner recurrence, circular windows, and triangular pair enumeration; no shared traversal helper is planned.

families.algorithmDescription: Evaluate a degree-at-most-five polynomial with Horner recurrence, reading coefficients in descending-power order.

validInputDomain.coefficients: degree+1 integers, each -9..9, highest power first.

families.outputMeaning: One signed integer polynomial value, bounded by -35154..35154.
semanticFailureModes: Reading coefficients in reverse order.
Skipping the constant term.
Processing degree rather than degree+1 coefficients.
families.cloneGroupRationale: One accumulator multiply-add recurrence with coefficient indexing; no polynomial-evaluation helper or related template appears in validation or test.

families.algorithmDescription: Find the maximum sum among the exactly N circular windows of a fixed length K in a bounded list, updating a rolling sum as each window advances.
families.outputMeaning: One signed integer maximum window sum, bounded by -792..792.
semanticFailureModes: Considering N-K+1 windows instead of N circular windows.
Wrong wrap index for incoming elements.
Initializing the maximum to zero for all-negative data.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Sliding-window deletion/insertion with modular indexing, not compaction or polynomial recurrence. No circular-window helper is used in another split.

families.algorithmDescription: Count strict inversions in a bounded sequence by visiting each index pair i<j and counting a[i]>a[j].

validInputDomain.length: Integer 0..8 followed by that many integers -99..99.

families.outputMeaning: One integer inversion count 0..28; equal values are not inversions.
semanticFailureModes: Counting equal values as inversions.
Omitting pairs involving the last element.
Counting reversed or duplicate pairs.
families.cloneGroupRationale: Triangular pair enumeration with strict comparison differs from full-matrix diagonal selection and circular-window maintenance. It does not sort or reuse F009's compare-and-swap network.
